proof_scope: The disposition gate distinguishes a completed bounded experiment cycle from the active continuous Persona Dream research-and-transfer program.

claims.proves: The checked registry keeps the Persona Dream program active, permits a completed disposition cycle, and rejects a false permanent-completion claim.
claims.does_not_prove: Any new cognitive, memory, personality, emotion, perceptual, or Chatterbox improvement.

capability_claims.description: Bounded experiments may terminate, but the Persona Dream program remains active and transfers findings to owning systems.

cases.name: continuous-program-with-complete-disposition-cycle
cases.description: Reads the real disposition registry and proves that the program is active while its current hypothesis cycle is complete.
command:
python ../scripts/check_dispositions.py --registry ../DISPOSITION_REGISTRY.json --strict --json --out /tmp/persona-dream-continuous-program-positive.json >/dev/null && python - <<'PY'
import json
r=json.load(open('/tmp/persona-dream-continuous-program-positive.json'))
assert r['status']=='PASS_DISPOSITION_REGISTRY', r
assert r['program_status']=='ACTIVE_CONTINUOUS', r
assert r['disposition_cycle_complete'] is True, r
assert r['immutable_goal_completion_claimed'] is False, r
policy=json.load(open('../DISPOSITION_REGISTRY.json'))['program']['claim_policy']
assert all(policy[k] for k in ('memory_trigger_causality','improvement','felt_or_perceived_emotion')), policy
print('PASS_CONTINUOUS_PROGRAM_BOUNDARY')
PY

cases.name: reject-false-permanent-completion
cases.description: Mutates a temporary registry copy to claim permanent completion and requires the disposition gate to reject it.
command:
python - <<'PY'
import json
p='../DISPOSITION_REGISTRY.json'
d=json.load(open(p))
d['program']['status']='COMPLETE'
d['program']['claim_policy']['improvement']=''
d['immutable_goal_completion_claimed']=True
open('/tmp/persona-dream-false-complete-registry.json','w').write(json.dumps(d))
PY
set +e
python ../scripts/check_dispositions.py --registry /tmp/persona-dream-false-complete-registry.json --json --out /tmp/persona-dream-continuous-program-negative.json >/dev/null
rc=$?
set -e
python - "$rc" <<'PY'
import json,sys
r=json.load(open('/tmp/persona-dream-continuous-program-negative.json'))
assert int(sys.argv[1])==1, sys.argv[1]
codes={x['code'] for x in r['failures']}
assert {'continuous_program_not_active','continuous_program_claimed_complete','program_claim_policy_missing'} <= codes, r
print('PASS_FALSE_PROGRAM_COMPLETION_REJECTED')
PY
